title: Cakkavatti
text: 2. Rañño bhikkhave cakkavattissa pātubhāvā sattannam ratanānam pātubhāvo hoti || || Katamesaṃ sattannaṃ || || 3. Cakkaratanassa pātubhāvo hoti || hatthiratanassaassaratanassa || maṇiratanassa || itthiratanassa || gahapatiratanassa- || parināyakaratanassa pātubhāvo hoti || || Rañño bhikkhave cakkavattissa pātubhāvā imesaṃ sattannam ratanānam pātubhāvo hoti || || 4. Tathāgatassa bhikkhave pātubhāvā arahato sammāsambuddhassa sattannam bojjhaṅgaratanānam pātubhāvo hoti || || Katamesaṃ sattannaṃ || || 5. Satisambojjhaṅgaratanassa pātubhāvo hoti || la-pe || || Upekhāsambojjhaṅgaratanassa pātubhavo hoti || || Tathāgatassa bhikkhave pātubhāvā arahato sammāsambuddhassa imesaṃ sattannam bojjhaṅgaratanānaṃ pātubhāvo hoti ti || ||
